# Test auto-export: init must not prime throttle before any issues exist.
# Regression guard for GH#2973: issuegraph init used to write an empty issues.jsonl
# and save export-state.json timestamp, causing the first real `issuegraph create`
# to be throttled for up to export.interval seconds (GH#3204 review).
issuegraph init --prefix test
stdout 'initialized successfully'
! exists .issuegraph/issues.jsonl
! exists .issuegraph/export-state.json

# First real write must export immediately, not wait for throttle to expire.
issuegraph config set export.auto true
issuegraph create 'First issue'
exists .issuegraph/issues.jsonl
grep 'First issue' .issuegraph/issues.jsonl
exists .issuegraph/export-state.json
